messages:
Ana: Flagging a cross-service sequence risk for tonight's 22:30 UTC window. Router header split + runtime quant flag + API v2 push need ordering.
Priy: do we need a hard stop if any stage spikes?
Ana: yes. Planned order: router-split -> console read-only schema -> runtime-quant canary -> api-v2 rollout. Console must ACK after schema migrate.
Priy: propose a hedged routing rule: if runtime_version < expected then route traffic to api:v1 for 90s. Helps avoid 500s.
Ana: agreed. Also add a short drain 45s after router-split to let routing tables converge.
deploy-bot: new plan job/1826-cutover created. Stages: router-split (canary 100%), console-migrate, runtime-quant (canary 10%), api-rollout (10->100). Automated rollback thresholds: router/runtime 5xx > 2% over 60s; api step 5xx > 3% over 120s or p99 +300ms.
Priy: can we lower api automated rollback to 2.5%? good to be conservative on user-facing APIs.
Ana: set api rollback to 2.5%. Also require ops-bot KV-warmcheck PASS before promoting runtime beyond canary.
ops-bot: `kv-warmcheck-1826` scheduled at stage boundary. Will post summary and last 50 log lines.
Priy: who owns Console ACK? I can take it. I'll post `Console ACK` once read-only migration shows no 500s for 60s.
Ana: add label `console-manual-gate` and pin the compatibility matrix to the ticket. Also include header pin so runtime can detect api:v2 traffic.
deploy-bot: label `console-manual-gate` added. Canary windows: router 2m, runtime 6m, api 12m. Manual holds required at console and ops-bot PASS.
Priy: playbook snippet for on-call: 
``
1) preflight: ./tools/check-compat --services router,runtime,api --schema hdr-v2
2) step A: router-split (deploy-bot) -> wait 45s drain
3) step B: console read-only migrate -> wait for Console ACK
4) step C: runtime quant canary 10% -> ops-bot KV-warmcheck -> monitor p95/p99
5) step D: pin api header -> rollout api v2 10->100
6) rollback: deploy-bot rollback job/1826-cutover --to=previous if thresholds hit
```
Ana: Dry-run 21:00 UTC, live 22:30 UTC. I'll ping 10m before. Keep channel open during window.
Priy: :thumbsup:
